ndae6cda215.headline: UK trade minister says 'no deal' Brexit more likely than not
ndae6cda215.summary: Britain's international trade minister stated that it is likely the UK will leave the EU without a divorce deal.
ndae6cda215.why: A no-deal Brexit would have significant economic and trade implications for the UK and EU, affecting markets and businesses.
ndae6cda215.why_moved: The increased likelihood of a no-deal Brexit raises concerns about trade barriers and economic disruption, impacting UK markets and currency.

n89451f07b2.headline: Bakery company Penam from the Agrofert group increased sales to 3.6 billion last year | Aktuálně.cz
n89451f07b2.summary: Penam, part of the Agrofert group, raised sales to 3.6 billion CZK last year while profit slightly decreased to 106 million CZK. The company modernized its Rosice bakery and is building a new dispatch area.
n89451f07b2.why: Penam is a significant player in the Czech food industry, and its performance reflects trends in consumer demand and industrial modernization.
